agents-md.description: Create or update AGENTS.md files for the project and its packages
agents-md.template:
You are generating AGENTS.md files for a pnpm workspace project called ja-tools.

## Rules
- Be concise - write the minimum necessary content
- Use inline comments in file trees (e.g., src/ # source code)
- Update existing files if they exist, create if they don't
- All AGENTS.md files should be as short as possible

## Root AGENTS.md
Create at ./AGENTS.md with:
- Project name as title
- 1-2 line description
- Project tree (first level only, inline comments)
- pnpm workspace note
- Useful commands table (install, dev, test, lint, check)
- Links to package AGENTS.md files

## Package AGENTS.md files
Create/update AGENTS.md in each package found in the pnpm workspace (use pnpm list --depth -1 to discover packages). With:
- Package name as title
- 1-2 line description
- Useful commands table using pnpm --filter <package> pattern
- File tree with inline comments (include important nested files)

Start by reading any existing AGENTS.md files and running pnpm list --depth -1 to discover all packages, then generate all AGENTS.md files.
